description: This file contains the class RepairAndClear which provides multiple maintenance and repair functions for the SuiteCRM application, such as database repair, extension rebuilding, cache clearing, and audit table rebuilding.

classes.name: RepairAndClear
classes.description: Main class providing various repair and cache clearing functionalities for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: repairAndClearAll
methods.description: Performs a series of maintenance actions based on selected action identifiers and modules.

methods.name: repairDatabase
methods.description: Includes and executes database repair routines.

methods.name: repairDatabaseSelectModules
methods.description: Repairs database tables for selected modules.

methods.name: rebuildAuditTables
methods.description: Rebuilds audit trail tables for modules.

methods.name: _rebuildAuditTablesHelper
methods.description: Helper function to rebuild audit tables for a given bean.

methods.name: _clearCache
methods.description: Recursively deletes files with specified extension in a directory.

methods.name: _getModuleNamePlural
methods.description: Gets the plural name of a module given its singular name.
